status_rule: Every status applies only to its adjacent statement. VERIFIED implementation facts do not verify psychometric quality or public claims.

allowed: Describe the exact FermatMind form, construct boundary and scoring behavior only where the inventory marks the fact VERIFIED.
Frame results as structured self-reflection and a working hypothesis.
State evidence gaps explicitly as UNKNOWN.
forbidden: Most accurate, scientifically proven, authoritative, certified, clinical-grade or diagnostic claims.
Claims that a score predicts health, hiring, admission, income, legal, financial or other high-stakes outcomes.
Claims of official affiliation, endorsement, licensing or exact equivalence to a named third-party instrument without version-bound public evidence.
Specific sample, norm, reliability, validity, percentile or reviewer claims not bound to public FermatMind evidence for the exact form.
Using theory-only research as validation of FermatMind items, translations, scoring, norms or reports.

identity.statement: The public registry exposes one FermatMind assessment with 144-item and 93-item forms. The repository does not establish that either form is the official Myers-Briggs Type Indicator instrument.

authority_owner.statement: fap-api registry/content packs own identity, forms and scoring contracts; the public API projects them and fap-web consumes them.

item_question_source.verified_facts: SHA-bound item banks and keyed scoring files exist.
item_question_source.unknowns: Public item provenance, license chain, development sample, translation/adaptation method and external reviewer are not documented in the reviewed public evidence.

scoring_method.statement: Keyed items contribute to E/I, S/N, T/F and J/P preference axes; the runtime derives axis summaries and a type code. Implementation and contract checks do not establish psychometric validity.

sample_norm.verified_facts: Repository norm files carry internal norm IDs and versions, including a form-93 provisional label.
sample_norm.unknowns: No public, exact-form sample size, recruitment frame, representativeness analysis, norm construction, reviewer or approved percentile interpretation was found.

reliability.statement: No public FermatMind form-specific reliability coefficient, sample or reviewed method was found.

validity.statement: No public FermatMind form-specific validity study was found; preference theory and runtime tests are not implementation validation.

reviewer.statement: No named psychometric reviewer and version-bound review date were found in public evidence.

items: Preference-style self-report is a reflection aid, not a diagnosis or fixed identity.
The public technical-note API returned SCALE_NOT_SUPPORTED at capture time.
Official Myers-Briggs instrument equivalence, licensing and endorsement remain UNKNOWN.

public_claim_scope.allowed: FermatMind offers 144-item and 93-item preference-style forms that summarize four preference axes for self-reflection; results are working hypotheses.
public_claim_scope.forbidden: Do not call the forms official MBTI instruments; do not claim licensed equivalence, diagnostic use, accuracy, reliability, validity, normative percentile meaning, stability or outcome prediction.

assessments.blocking_reason: Identity/forms/scoring are traceable, but public item provenance, sample/norm methods, reliability, validity, reviewer and technical manual remain incomplete.

identity.statement: The public registry exposes 120-item and 90-item FermatMind Big Five forms covering five domains and thirty facets.

authority_owner.statement: fap-api registry/content packs own identity, forms and scoring contracts; public APIs are the frontend authority boundary.

item_question_source.verified_facts: Repository source catalog and bilingual item banks exist and the implementation is structured around five domains and thirty facets.
item_question_source.unknowns: The reviewed public evidence does not prove exact equivalence to BFI-2, NEO inventories or an IPIP instrument, nor a complete public license/adaptation/reviewer chain for the current forms.

scoring_method.statement: Five-point self-report items, including reverse-keyed items, feed facet and domain means. The implementation may calculate norm-referenced outputs or use a provisional raw-mean fallback; this does not authorize public norm or percentile claims.

sample_norm.verified_facts: Compiled norm files and internal source identifiers exist for both forms.
sample_norm.unknowns: No public exact-form sample size, recruitment, representativeness, weighting, norm-review record or claim-eligible percentile contract was found.

reliability.statement: No public current-form FermatMind reliability coefficients with sample and method were found.

validity.statement: Big Five theory is well established, but no public study validates the exact FermatMind forms, translations, scoring and reports.

reviewer.statement: The authority ledger records the named-reviewer gap; no public version-bound psychometric review was found.

items: Trait scores are continuous self-report descriptions, not diagnoses or fixed identities.
The public technical-note API returned SCALE_NOT_SUPPORTED at capture time.
External Big Five research is THEORY_ONLY and does not validate FermatMind implementation.

public_claim_scope.allowed: FermatMind offers 120-item and 90-item self-report forms that summarize five continuous Big Five domains and associated facets for self-reflection.
public_claim_scope.forbidden: Do not claim exact BFI-2, NEO or IPIP instrument equivalence; do not publish precise norm, percentile, reliability, validity, reviewer, diagnosis or outcome-prediction claims from this inventory.

assessments.blocking_reason: Implementation is traceable, but public form provenance, norms, psychometric results, reviewer and supported technical note remain incomplete.

identity.statement: The public registry exposes a 105-item Likert form and a 144-item forced-choice form as distinct score spaces.

authority_owner.statement: fap-api registry, content packs and Enneagram technical-note service own the public method contract.

item_question_source.verified_facts: Versioned internal source assets and compiled item banks exist for both forms.
item_question_source.unknowns: Public item provenance, license/adaptation chain, development sample and named item-reviewer evidence were not found.

scoring_method.statement: The 105-item form aggregates weighted -2..2 Likert contributions across nine types; the 144-item form aggregates forced-choice wins/exposures. Both expose within-form Top-3/gap summaries, not standardized scores or percentiles, and must not be numerically compared across forms.

sample_norm.verified_facts: The public technical note explicitly withholds standardized-score and percentile interpretation.
sample_norm.unknowns: No public norm sample, sample size, recruitment frame or norm construction was found.

reliability.statement: Retake stability is pending sample and the public technical note does not report a form-specific reliability estimate.

validity.statement: The public note does not claim clinical validity, hiring suitability or cross-form numeric equivalence; external Enneagram research is not validation of FermatMind forms.

reviewer.statement: No named psychometric reviewer with version-bound public review date was found.

items: The two forms occupy different score spaces and are not directly comparable.
Scores are descriptive within-form outputs, not standardized scores or percentiles.
No clinical, hiring, accuracy or prediction claim is authorized.

public_claim_scope.allowed: FermatMind offers distinct 105-item Likert and 144-item forced-choice Enneagram forms that provide within-form descriptive nine-type and Top-3 pattern summaries for self-reflection.
public_claim_scope.forbidden: Do not call the outputs standardized, percentile-based, clinically valid, suitable for hiring, accurate, predictive or numerically equivalent across forms.

assessments.blocking_reason: A public technical note exists, but public item provenance, norm sample, reliability/validity results, reviewer and changelog remain incomplete.

identity.statement: The public registry exposes one flagship RIASEC interest assessment with 60-item and 140-item forms.

authority_owner.statement: fap-api registry, content packs and RIASEC technical-note service own the public method contract.

item_question_source.verified_facts: Versioned internal design assets and compiled item banks exist for both forms.
item_question_source.unknowns: Public item lineage, adaptation/license chain, development sample and named item reviewer were not found; O*NET sources validate their own instrument, not FermatMind forms.

scoring_method.statement: The 60-item form sums ten items for each R/I/A/S/E/C dimension and maps results to 0-100. The 140-item form uses 22 items per dimension plus eight quality items and weights activity/environment/role components 0.70/0.15/0.15. The two forms are separate score spaces.

sample_norm.verified_facts: The public note documents within-form scoring and rejects raw cross-form deltas.
sample_norm.unknowns: No public representative sample, sample size, norm construction or percentile interpretation was found.

reliability.statement: No public current-form reliability coefficient, sample or method was found.

validity.statement: RIASEC theory and O*NET Interest Profiler evidence do not validate FermatMind's 60-item or 140-item forms; no public FermatMind validity result was found.

reviewer.statement: No named psychometric reviewer with a version-bound review date was found in public evidence.

items: RIASEC measures expressed interests, not ability, personality, values, job fit or future outcomes.
The 140-item form is not authorized as more accurate than the 60-item form.
Occupation links are examples for exploration, not recommendations, hiring decisions or guarantees.

public_claim_scope.allowed: FermatMind offers distinct 60-item and 140-item RIASEC forms that summarize expressed interests across six dimensions and can provide examples for further career exploration.
public_claim_scope.forbidden: Do not claim ability, personality, values, job fit, hiring suitability, career recommendation, outcome prediction, cross-form numeric equivalence or that 140 items is more accurate.

assessments.blocking_reason: A bounded public method note exists, but item lineage, sample/norm evidence, reliability, validity, reviewer and public changelog remain incomplete.

assessments.display_name: FermatMind reasoning practice assessment (legacy public code IQ_RAVEN)

identity.statement: The public registry retains an IQ_RAVEN code/slug, while the reviewed runtime pack contains a FermatMind owner-original 30-item bank. The legacy name is not evidence of equivalence to Raven's Progressive Matrices.

authority_owner.statement: fap-api registry/content pack owns public identity and runtime scoring; the repository bank declares FermatMind owner-original content.

item_question_source.verified_facts: The current 30-item bank declares owner-original items and prohibits public answer-key/solution exposure.
item_question_source.unknowns: Any Raven item lineage, licensed relationship, equivalence, adaptation evidence or external item reviewer remains UNKNOWN.

scoring_method.statement: The private key yields a raw score from 0 to 30 plus NPR, VSI and VSPR domain summaries. The runtime service marks the item bank production_ready=false, and the contract disables IQ/percentile claims without an eligible population norm.

sample_norm.verified_facts: The owner-original bank requires a claim-eligible population norm before IQ or percentile interpretation; a beta standard-score path is marked production_normed=false and claim_eligible=false.
sample_norm.unknowns: No public eligible norm record, sample size, recruitment, representativeness, locking/review evidence or percentile authority was found.

reliability.statement: No public reliability estimate with sample and method for the owner-original 30-item bank was found.

validity.statement: No public validity study or evidence of equivalence to Raven's Progressive Matrices was found.

reviewer.statement: No named psychometric reviewer and version-bound public review date were found.

items: Treat the exposed activity as reasoning practice with raw/domain summaries only when the runtime contract permits.
Do not expose item text, answer keys, solutions or private evidence paths.
The public technical-note API returned SCALE_NOT_SUPPORTED and public lookup exposed no forms at capture time.

public_claim_scope.allowed: Only describe the current owner-original 30-item implementation as reasoning practice with a raw score and bounded domain summaries when those outputs are actually exposed by the public runtime.
public_claim_scope.forbidden: Do not call it Raven or an official/equivalent Raven instrument; do not claim IQ estimation, percentile, population norm, intelligence diagnosis, accuracy, reliability, validity or education/employment outcome prediction.

assessments.blocking_reason: The runtime bank is traceable, but public form exposure, Raven relationship, production readiness, eligible norms, psychometric results, reviewer and technical manual remain unverified.
